name: HumanEval_6_parse_nested_parens
completion:
# Split the string by spaces
  groups = paren_string.split(' ')
  # Initialize an array to store the maximum nesting level for each group
  max_nesting_levels = []
  # Iterate over each group
  groups.each do |group|
    # Initialize a counter for the current nesting level
    nesting_level = 0
    # Iterate over each character in the group
    group.chars.each do |char|
      # If the character is an opening parenthesis, increment the nesting level
      if char == '('
        nesting_level += 1
      # If the character is a closing parenthesis, decrement the nesting level
      elsif char == ')'
        nesting_level -= 1
      # If the nesting level is 0, it means we are back to the start of the group
      elsif nesting_level == 0
        # Reset the nesting level
        nesting_level = 0
      # If the nesting level is greater than 0, it means we are still inside the parentheses
      else
        # Update the maximum nesting level for this group
        max_nesting_levels << nesting_level
      end
    end
  end
  # Return the array of maximum nesting levels
  max_nesting_levels
end

name: HumanEval_10_make_palindrome
completion:
# Find the longest palindromic suffix
  longest_palindromic_suffix = ''
  i = 0
  while i < string.length
    # Check if the substring from i to end is a palindrome
    if string[i..end].to_s == string[i..end].reverse.to_s
      longest_palindromic_suffix = string[i..end]
      break
    end
    i += 1
  end
  
  # If no palindromic suffix, return the original string
  if longest_palindromic_suffix == ''
    return string
  end
  
  # Find the longest palindromic prefix
  longest_palindromic_prefix = ''
  j = 0
  while j < string.length
    # Check if the substring from 0 to j is a palindrome
    if string[0..j].to_s == string[0..j].reverse.to_s
      longest_palindromic_prefix = string[0..j]
      break
    end
    j += 1
  end
  
  # If no palindromic prefix, return the original string
  if longest_palindromic_prefix == ''
    return string
  end
  
  # Append the reverse of the prefix to the end of the string
  # This creates a palindrome
  result = string + longest_palindromic_prefix.reverse.to_s
  
  # If the result is the same as the original string, return it
  if result == string
    return string
  end
  
  # Return the result
  result
end
